title: California autonomous-vehicle public-road testing: 2023-2024 reporting period
summary: Permit holders reported 4,498,066 autonomous-mode public-road test miles, including 552,895 driverless miles. Nine reporting companies had ceased testing and withdrawn from the program.
key_findings: Permit holders reported 4,498,066 autonomous-mode public-road test miles, including 552,895 driverless miles.
Method: Annual permit-holder reports of autonomous-mode public-road testing miles and disengagements.
Denominator: Reported autonomous-mode public-road testing miles in California under DMV testing permits.
why_it_matters: This observation adds one of three time points for the california autonomous-vehicle public-road testing series and keeps its unit, denominator, period, geography, method, attribution, and series-break context attached.
ftfn_relevance: Adds one of twelve Phase 56A primary records for carrier, operator, and mission service outcomes.
Supports a within-domain time series without creating a cross-domain score.
Makes revision, denominator, and method limits visible before a direction is described.
evidence_limits: Nine reporting companies had ceased testing and withdrawn from the program.
The observation is bounded to California, United States and the stated period.
The denominator is Reported autonomous-mode public-road testing miles in California under DMV testing permits.
Two-point movement is not presented as a durable trend without an explicit caveat.
